title: dedicated-autoscaler-priority-burst-controls-throughput-guarantees-util-reporting-enhancement
author: Ravi Patel
description: Motivation: customers expect predictable throughput for Dedicated fleets while allowing short bursts and priority routing. This PR extends the dedicated autoscaler to support weighted priority lanes, token-bucket burst controls per-priority, and end-to-end utilization reporting so SREs and customers can reason about capacity versus consumed burst credits. Changes: 1) Introduced PriorityAutoscaler orchestration layer that tracks queues per-priority and enforces throughput guarantees while allowing configurable burst windows. 2) Token-bucket implementation moved to shared library with configurable refill rates and burst caps exposed in the DedicatedConfig CRD. 3) Added synchronous util reporting pipeline that emits per-fleet, per-model and per-priority metrics (util_pct, burst_credit_used, throttled_requests) to the metrics backend and to the Console tenant dashboard. 4) Updated rollout logic to prefer fallbacks when throughput guarantees cannot be satisfied and to surface actionable reasons in logs/traces. 5) End-to-end tests and a benchmark harness for priority burst scenarios. Checklist: - [x] Design doc linked (ENG-4281) - [x] Unit tests for token-bucket and priority queue logic - [x] Integration tests with autoscaler + routing - [x] Metrics emitted and Console dashboards updated - [x] Backwards-compatible config changes - [x] Release notes included Backwards compatibility: CRD additions are additive; default behavior unchanged unless the new priority field is populated. See release notes for migration guidance.

feat(config): extend DedicatedConfig CRD with priority/burst fields

release_notes: Added PriorityAutoscaler with per-priority throughput guarantees and token-bucket burst controls. New DedicatedConfig fields: priority_tiers (list), burst_window_ms, burst_capacity, refill_rate. Metrics: dedicated.fleet.util_pct, dedicated.fleet.burst_credit_used, dedicated.fleet.throttled_requests emitted per-model and per-priority. Backwards compatible; enable new behavior by populating priority_tiers. See docs/rfcs/4281-priority-autoscaler.md for migration steps.
